I'm Sebas Eliëns, an independent data scientist based in the Netherlands. My background is in physics, and I now work on data and analysis projects — mostly in areas related to sustainability and social issues.

This site is where I share work, notes, and the occasional longer piece. If you have a project that could use a data scientist, feel free to get in touch.
